name: Diamond Ripple
description: Nested diamonds spreading from the middle of the sheet, their bands swelling and thinning as they go out.

code.style: --rule: ( --a: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); --cx: $(50 - 100 * @dx); --cy: $(50 - 100 * @dy); --da: $(round((abs(@dx) + abs(@dy) - 1 + 0.5) * 100) / 100); --ha: $(round((0.1 + 0.32 * (0.5 + 0.5 * cos(PI * da / (min(@X, @Y) / 2) * 1.5))) * 10000) / 10000); --oa: $(round((100 * max(0, da + ha)) * 100) / 100); --ia: $(round((100 * max(0, da - ha)) * 100) / 100); --db: $(round((abs(@dx) + abs(@dy) - 1 + 1.5) * 100) / 100); --hb: $(round((0.1 + 0.32 * (0.5 + 0.5 * cos(PI * db / (min(@X, @Y) / 2) * 1.5))) * 10000) / 10000); --ob: $(round((100 * max(0, db + hb)) * 100) / 100); --ib: $(round((100 * max(0, db - hb)) * 100) / 100); --ra: polygon($(cx + oa)% $(cy + 0)%, $(cx + 0)% $(cy + oa)%, $(cx + 0 - oa)% $(cy + 0)%, $(cx + 0)% $(cy + 0 - oa)%, $(cx + oa)% $(cy + 0)%, $(cx + ia)% $(cy + 0)%, $(cx + 0)% $(cy + 0 - ia)%, $(cx + 0 - ia)% $(cy + 0)%, $(cx + 0)% $(cy + ia)%, $(cx + ia)% $(cy + 0)%); --rb: polygon($(cx + ob)% $(cy + 0)%, $(cx + 0)% $(cy + ob)%, $(cx + 0 - ob)% $(cy + 0)%, $(cx + 0)% $(cy + 0 - ob)%, $(cx + ob)% $(cy + 0)%, $(cx + ib)% $(cy + 0)%, $(cx + 0)% $(cy + 0 - ib)%, $(cx + 0 - ib)% $(cy + 0)%, $(cx + 0)% $(cy + ib)%, $(cx + ib)% $(cy + 0)%); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @var(--a); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--ra); clip-path: @var(--ra); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--rb); clip-path: @var(--rb); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
